blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – On Week 10 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, the prosecution team started presentation of evidence on Article II, which accuses Duterte of amassing unexplained wealth disproportionate to her lawful income, filing incomplete or untruthful Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALNs) from 2022 to 2024, and earning income from prohibited interests. Retired Sandiganbayan Presiding Justice Amparo Cabotaje-Tang took the witness stand as the prosecution’s first witness for Article II after the Senate impeachment court overruled the defense’s bid to exclude her.
